paragraphs: The 435d has been a mainstay of the 4 Series diesel range since 2012, spanning two generations under one badge. Early F32/F33/F36 models from 2012 to 2015 use the N47, a 2.0-litre diesel that's part of a family known for a specific timing chain issue. From late 2015 onwards, across both the F32/F33/F36 and later the F32/F33/F36, the 435d switched to the B47, a newer, significantly more reliable unit that doesn't share the N47's timing chain concerns. Knowing which one your car has matters, because the components and the known wear pattern differ - which is exactly why we confirm your exact engine by registration before quoting.
about.boldParagraph: The 435d is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.

compatibility.intro: Because the 435d was only sold with the N57 engine across a single generation, compatibility is simpler than with some other variants. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:
